Jonah.title: Jonah
Jonah.question: Will the prophet accept mercy when it reaches people he resents?

chapters.title: Run to the Sea
chapters.game: Choose cargo and board the ship going the wrong way.

chapters.title: The Storm
chapters.game: Secure the deck and uncover Jonah’s flight.

chapters.title: Into the Deep
chapters.game: Navigate sinking currents toward the great fish.

chapters.title: Prayer Below
chapters.game: Reassemble Jonah’s prayer from psalm fragments.

chapters.title: The Warning
chapters.game: Deliver the short message through the great city.

chapters.title: Nineveh Repents
chapters.game: Coordinate fasting from palace to livestock.

chapters.title: The Plant
chapters.game: Manage shade, worm, and hot wind.

chapters.title: The Question
chapters.game: Compare Jonah’s pity for a plant with God’s pity for a city.
